items.title: Alsona
items.source_text: Alsona AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today. Sales SaaS Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Maxma
items.source_text: Maxma The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits. Marketing Advertising Artificial Intelligence

items.title: TK by Medium
items.source_text: TK by Medium An agentic notebook to build your best thinking What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools. Productivity Notes Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Latch.ai
items.source_text: Latch.ai Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Accounting

items.title: Seldon
items.source_text: Seldon Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free. API Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence
